descriptions.notStarted: I should go visit the MapleStory Administrator. I heard MapleStory is celebrating its 2nd birthday, and she may have something in store for me...
descriptions.inProgress: The MapleStory Administrator said we'll be celebrating the anniversary in style and that there is a #bRED birthday present#k for me to look for. Now, where must that be...\n\n#t4031306# #b#c4031306#/1#k
descriptions.completed: I found the #bRED birthday present#k and gave it to the Maple Administrator. She opened the present for me, and gave me what was inside. That was pretty sweet!
